# Test valid URLs
tests = [
    \(''example.com'', ''https://example.com/''\),
    \(''http://Example.COM/page/'', ''http://example.com/page''\),
    \(''https://test.org/path?q=1#frag'', ''https://test.org/path?q=1''\),

]

    result = validate_and_normalize\(raw\)
    status = ''PASS'' if result == expected else f''FAIL \(got {result}\)''
    print\(f''{raw} -> {status}''\)

    try:
        validate_and_normalize\(bad\)
        print\(f''{bad} -> FAIL \(should have raised\)''\)
    except \(URLValidationError, ValueError\) as e:
